name: baseUrl
stmt: static String get baseUrl { if (dotenv.isInitialized) { try { final url = dotenv.env['BASE_URL']; if (url != null && url.isNotEmpty) return url; } catch (_) {} } return "https://clubby-andy-irksomely.ngrok-free.dev"; }

name: chatWebSocket
signature: static String chatWebSocket(String conversationId, String token)
stmt: static String chatWebSocket(String conversationId, String token) { final wsBase = baseUrl .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^http://'), 'ws://') .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^https://'), 'wss://'); return "$wsBase/ws/chat/$conversationId/?token=$token"; }
